svg.title: PersonaCraftPro resume editor walkthrough
svg.desc: An animated, cursor-guided preview of the real editor: select a template, edit the resume in the center, adjust profile settings in the right panel, and sign in with Google for cloud saves.
svg.text: Click any name, heading, bullet, skill, or paragraph on the page to edit
Quality Engineering professional with experience in test automation, scalable test frameworks,
and delivering reliable software. Skilled at collaborating across teams to improve product quality
Designed and maintained scalable UI and API automation suites.
Improved regression reliability and reduced repetitive manual effort.
Collaborated with developers and product teams to resolve release risks.
Built automated tests and reusable test utilities.
Reported defects with clear reproduction steps and impact analysis.
Playwright · Selenium · JavaScript · TypeScript · API Testing · CI/CD · SQL · Git

g.text: Choose a resume design from the real Templates panel
Click the resume and edit your details right on the page
Update your profile and photo in Design & properties
Sign in with Google to keep a private cloud copy
